title: The Qunut du‘a with its meaning
intro: The du‘a we recite in the 3rd rak‘ah of Witr – learn it part by part, with its meaning.

learn.html: The Qunut du‘a is recited in Witr, at the end of Isha. In the 3rd rak‘ah, after Al-Fatiha and a surah, we say the takbir (Allaahu akbar) and recite the Qunut. Then we finish the rak‘ah as usual.

learn.label: The Qunut – part 1
learn.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْتَعِينُكَ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَنَسْتَهْدِيكَ وَنُؤْمِنُ بِكَ وَنَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ وَنَتَوَكَّلُ عَلَيْكَ وَنُثْنِي عَلَيْكَ الْخَيْرَ كُلَّهُ
learn.tr: Allaahumma innaa nasta‘eenuka wa nastaghfiruka wa nastahdeeka, wa nu’minu bika wa natoobu ilayka wa natawakkalu ‘alayka, wa nuthnee ‘alaykal-khayra kullahu.
learn.en: O Allah, we ask You for help, we ask You for forgiveness and we ask You for guidance. We believe in You, we turn to You in repentance and we rely on You. We praise You with every good.

learn.label: The Qunut – part 2
learn.ar: نَشْكُرُكَ وَلَا نَكْفُرُكَ وَنَخْلَعُ وَنَتْرُكُ مَنْ يَفْجُرُكَ
learn.tr: Nashkuruka wa laa nakfuruka, wa nakhla‘u wa natruku man yafjuruk.
learn.en: We thank You and we are not ungrateful to You. We turn away from and leave whoever disobeys You.

learn.label: The Qunut – part 3
learn.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَلَكَ نُصَلِّي وَنَسْجُدُ وَإِلَيْكَ نَسْعَى وَنَحْفِدُ نَرْجُو رَحْمَتَكَ وَنَخْشَى عَذَابَكَ إِنَّ عَذَابَكَ بِالْكُفَّارِ مُلْحِقٌ
learn.tr: Allaahumma iyyaaka na‘budu, wa laka nusallee wa nasjudu, wa ilayka nas‘aa wa nahfidu. Narjoo rahmataka wa nakhshaa ‘adhaabaka, inna ‘adhaabaka bil-kuffaari mulhiq.
learn.en: O Allah, You alone we worship, to You we pray and to You we prostrate. To You we strive and we hurry to serve You. We hope for Your mercy and we fear Your punishment. Truly, Your punishment reaches the disbelievers.

learn.text: 💡 What we say to Allah in the Qunut

items.label: We ask for help, forgiveness and guidance
We believe in Allah and rely on Him
We thank Him and are not ungrateful
We worship, pray and prostrate to Him alone
We hope for His mercy and fear His punishment
